title: Can I BEAT Behind the Mirror?
summary: chess.com community variant Behind the Mirror vs viewers (theJmeister7, Delhy) at 10 minutes, played as Black: two mirrored 6-file halves split by a 2-file void and joined by arches of extension squares above and below (knights start on isolated squares beyond the arches). Each side has a royal king (fleur-de-lis, check counter 5) on one half and a playable non-royal king on the other; checkmate or five checks on the royal king win; no castling.
rules: Board: two 6x8 halves + 2-file void, arches of 4 and 2 squares above/below, isolated knight squares (still maxres2).
Each side: royal king + playable king; the playable king is an ordinary piece (0:06-0:09).
Checkmating the royal king wins; five checks on it also win (1:34-2:04).
win_condition: Checkmate the royal king or give it five checks.
